Context: 1. Immediate relief to the family of an employee who dies while in service

2. Sanctioned immediately by the Head of Office or the Gazetted Officer at the lowest level under whom the deceased official was last working and payment made expeditiously either from imprests or from other sources or by drawing money from the Bank.
2. Timely payment.No formal application from the bereaved family is necessary.
3. Payment in cash.DD0s are permitted to draw and disburse the amount of relief in cash. -OM, dated 30-4-2021.
